text:
maria-security: Heads up — mandatory FIDO2 / hardware security key enrollment for anyone with production access. Enrollment window is 14 days from now. After the window enforcement begins and accounts without a registered key will be blocked from prod resources. See the onboarding doc: https://intranet.redwood/security/fido-onboarding :lock:

samir-eng-sre: Are contractors included in this? We have a couple external infra folks who need temporary prod access this month.

maria-security: Yes — contractors with prod roles are included. If you have a short-term vendor, open a sec ticket (sec.redwood.com/new) to request an exception and provide dates. Exceptions are short-lived and require manager + security approval.

claire-people-ops: People Ops will coordinate issuing keys for onsite staff and subsidizing purchase for remote employees. If you need a key ordered, fill this form: https://forms.redwood/secure-key-request. Please do that within 48 hours.

mike-sre: Quick enrollment notes for folks doing SSH/API auth:
```
# generate a resident SSH key (example)
ssh-keygen -t ecdsa-sk -f ~/.ssh/id_ecdsa_sk -C "you@redwood.com"
# add to agent (Linux)
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ecdsa_sk
```
Web app / Okta enrollment: go to Profile > Extra Verification > Add Security Key. If you hit issues, report with screenshots to #eng-support.

okta-bot: New policy created: "HWKey-MFA-Prod". Enforcement scheduled: 2026-04-15T08:00:00Z. Affected groups: prod-admins, prod-deployers, db-admins.

jess-contracts: If we need to ship a temporary key to a vendor, what's the shipping workflow?

claire-people-ops: For vendors we recommend they use their own FIDO2 device. If shipping is required, create a purchase request and tag it with "vendor-key"; we ship via tracked courier and update the sec ticket with tracking.

maria-security: A few important notes:
- This protects us from phishing/credential theft and addresses recent attack surface findings from our pentest.
- If you lose your key, create a sec ticket immediately; do not attempt workarounds.
- IAM will start automated checks on April 15 to identify unregistered prod accounts and notify managers. Final cut-off enforcement 7 days after initial enforcement.

samir-eng-sre: One more — will apps that use service accounts or CI need hardware keys?

maria-security: No — service accounts/CI should use OIDC or short-lived certs. We will not require hardware keys on non-human principals. We will publish migration steps to OIDC for CI later this week.

mike-sre: I'll schedule two drop-in office hours next Tue/Wed in #eng-support to help folks enroll, test SSH, and troubleshoot agent issues.

maria-security: Thanks all — please read the doc and act within 14 days. If you have blockers, escalate to me or open a sec ticket. :calendar:
